title: [maintainer] refactor(app-shell): move Studio's nav item inspector out of StudioDesignSurface.tsx (slice 1)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBCE4YXYCrA6G1yrthEDVvNJ)_

Refs #29988

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把 Studio 编辑应用导航时右侧的「菜单项检查器」及其目标选择器(978 行)原样搬进同目录新文件 `StudioNavItemInspector.tsx`,主文件 12,882 → 11,884 行。
- 为什么改:#29988 要把这个 1.2 万行的文件按裁定 #24586 A 逐片只搬不改地拆到 1 万行以下;这是第 1 片,并附整份接缝表规划后续各片。
- 风险与回滚:无行为变化,搬走的代码逐字节一致,只多了 import 和一个 `export`;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 顶部 import 与切口处的再导出;`StudioNavItemInspector.tsx` 的 import 段;`homeRecoveryRedirectsFollowDeclaration-7373.test.ts` 的读取清单。
- 两分钟验证:在本分支跑下方「Verification」里的 `cmp` 一行命令,预期无任何输出(逐字节相同)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Seam table

Measured on `origin/main` `88cd0ab58`, where `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` is 12,882 lines. Every seam is a set of module-scope declarations (the file has no component defined inside another component), so "inbound" below is what the seam reads from the rest of the module and which hooks it calls; no seam closes over another component's state. Line ranges are base lines, comments included. "Left" is the file's line count after that row and every row above it; row 1 is measured, the rest are estimates (lines removed, plus about two import lines per slice).

| # | Seam | Base lines | Size | Reads from the rest of the module · hooks it calls | Imported by | Risk | Left |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **1** | **Nav item inspector**: `StudioNavItemInspector`, its nav target helpers (`usePackageNavTargets`, `NavTargetSelect`, `NavUrlFields`, badge variants, `navVisibleText`) and `StudioPicker` | 3376–4353 | 978 | nothing · `useMetadataClient`, `useMetadataLocale`, `useNavTargetLabel` | `InterfacesPillar` (inspector); `DataPillar`, `AutomationsPillar` (`StudioPicker`); 7 test files import the inspector through `./StudioDesignSurface` | low: self-contained, props only | **11,884** (measured) |

Carries the 7373 test's `const homePath = useHomePath()` needle, so that reader's `alsoReads` gains the new module | ≈ 11,223 |

It is what lets rows 7–10 move without an import cycle back into this file | ≈ 10,119 |
| 6 | Data pillar helpers: `addedFieldName`, `extensionFieldsOf`, `STUDIO_SYSTEM_FIELD_NAMES`, `renderStudioGridList`, the CEL panel stamps, `formPreviewSource`, the OWD option keys | 483–500, 7260–7500 | 259 | nothing · no hooks | `DataPillar` only; 1 test imports `renderStudioGridList` | low: pure helpers | ≈ 9,862 (under 10,000) |
| 7 | `AccessPillar` with its new-similar arrival reader and `StudioNameLabel` | 2924–2948, 11939–12880 | 967 | rows 4 and 5 (`pairIdOf`, the kit) · 11 hooks | `StudioDesignSurfaceBody`; 7 test files | medium: one whole stateful component, moved whole; after rows 4–5 | ≈ 8,897 |
| 8 | `AutomationsPillar` | 10087–11937 | 1,851 | rows 1, 4, 5 · 21 hooks | `StudioDesignSurfaceBody`; 23+ test files | medium: whole stateful component; after rows 4–5 | ≈ 7,048 |
| 9 | `DataPillar` | 7504–9736 | 2,233 | rows 1, 2, 5, 6 · 17 hooks | `StudioDesignSurfaceBody`; 38+ test files | medium: whole stateful component; holds three `clickableNonControlCensus-13461` rows keyed by this file, which move with it | ≈ 4,817 |

| 11 | `StudioDesignSurface` / `StudioDesignSurfaceBody`, `PILLARS`, `METADATA_AREA_TAB`, `PILLAR_FOR_SURFACE_TYPE`, publish-refusal and backfill helpers | 459–523, 685–697, 811–820, 1568–2922 | ≈ 1,425 | rows 2, 5, 7–10 · 11 hooks | the package's `index.ts`, the console's lazy Studio route, 51 test files | stays: this is the file | — |

**What cannot move without a logic change.** Anything below the whole-component level of rows 7–11: a pillar's rail, canvas or inspector section, or the surface body's publish flow. Each is JSX plus handlers that close over that component's own `useState` / `useCallback` values, so taking one out needs new props or a hook with parameters, which is a logic change. None of it is needed: rows 1–6 are pure helpers or prop-only components and together bring the file to about 9,860 lines, under the 10,000 bar.

**Serial order the table implies.** Rows 2–6 in any order (none reads another), then rows 7–10 only after row 5, so the pillars never import back from this file.

## What changes

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioNavItemInspector.tsx` (new): row 1, base lines 3376–4353, byte for byte, under a copyright line, a three-line module comment and the imports the block reads. The one edit inside the block is `export` on `function StudioPicker(`, which `DataPillar` and `AutomationsPillar` now import.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: the block is gone; at the cut sits `export { StudioNavItemInspector };` with a one-line comment (the same shape as the file's existing `export { StudioRefusalStrip };`), so the 7 test files that import the inspector from `./StudioDesignSurface` are unchanged. It imports `StudioNavItemInspector` and `StudioPicker` from the new module beside its `StudioRefusalStrip` import, and drops the 24 import bindings only the block used.
- By-path readers (ruling 6597555122 item 3): the two tests that scan this file's whole text by path now read the new module too.
  - `ui/packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/homeRecoveryRedirectsFollowDeclaration-7373.test.ts`: a site gains an optional `alsoReads` list; the Studio site lists `StudioNavItemInspector.tsx`, and both scans (no `/home` literal; the policy expression is present) read the site's file followed by its `alsoReads`.
  - `ui/scripts/__tests__/spec-symbol-ledger-app-shell-7265.test.ts`: `SITES` gains `StudioNavItemInspector.tsx`, so rule 1's "no spec-named local declaration" scan covers the moved text.
- `.changeset/29988-studio-nav-item-inspector-module.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, "internal: move-only".

## Tests

No behaviour changes, so no new behaviour test. The existing suites run unchanged; results are in Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- **The by-path readers, one by one.** `git grep` of `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` / `studio-design/StudioDesignSurface` over `scripts/**`, `ui/scripts/**` and every ui test file found three tests that read the file by path. Two scan its whole text and gained the new module (above). The third, `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/clickableNonControlCensus-13461.test.ts`, does not read a list: it walks every `src/` file itself and keys its declared rows by file and handler. None of its rows sits in the moved block (the block's two clickable elements are `<button>`s), so it needs no edit and keeps passing. Every other hit is a comment. No gate under `scripts/**` names the file.
- **One prose anchor now names the mount file, not the definition.** `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json` (an item's `source` list) cites `StudioDesignSurface.tsx (the Studio menu-entry inspector)`. The inspector is still mounted from that file, but defined in the new module. This PR leaves it alone: a checklist item edit is outside this slice's claimed file surface. The seat can re-point it with the next checklist touch.
- **A stray section comment travels with the block.** `/** Interfaces pillar — real App nav · live canvas · inspector. */` sits just above the inspector's own doc comment at base and moved with it, unchanged, because the slice is byte-identical.
- **Serial check.** No open PR touched `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` at the seat's claim (00:30Z) or when this branch was pushed (re-read before push; see Verification). The branch is rebased on `origin/main` `0b99c2b16`; nothing on `main` after `88cd0ab58` touches `ui/`.

## Verification

<details><summary>Move-only proof: byte-compare and the moved-lines diff</summary>

Byte-compare of the moved block (base lines 3376–4353 against the new module from its line 53, with the one `export` taken off):

```
git show 88cd0ab58:ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx | sed -n 3376,4353p > /tmp/base-block
tail -n +53 ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioNavItemInspector.tsx | sed 's/^export function StudioPicker(/function StudioPicker(/' | cmp /tmp/base-block -
```

Silent (identical): 978 lines, sha256 `cfbbe19e358607a6…` on both sides.

`git diff --color=always --color-moved=zebra 88cd0ab58 HEAD -- ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/`: 999 lines removed and 999 added are coloured as moved (the 978-line block plus 21 import specifier lines). Every line NOT coloured as moved:

```

-  renamedLabel,

-function StudioPicker({
+// objectstack#29988 — the nav item inspector moved to its own module; re-exported for its pins.
+export { StudioNavItemInspector };

```

plus the new module's header comment and its import lines. Nothing else.
</details>

<details><summary>Declaration files (ruling 6348891160's bar)</summary>

`@object-ui/app-shell` builds with `tsc`, one `.d.ts` per source file. Base declarations were emitted from the base source of the two files into a scratch `outDir` under the lock, then the tree was restored (`git diff HEAD` empty).

- 698 `.d.ts` files other than `StudioDesignSurface.d.ts`: 697 byte-identical. `chrome/ErrorBoundary.d.ts` differs on one line, `render()`'s return union, with `import("react").JSX.Element` printed in a different position: identical after sorting union members in place. Positive control: the same normaliser on a copy with `bigint` dropped from that union reports a difference.
- `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.d.ts`: the inspector's declaration is replaced by `import { StudioNavItemInspector } from './StudioNavItemInspector.js';` and `export { StudioNavItemInspector };`. Declared-surface digest of `dist/index.d.ts` plus `StudioDesignSurface.d.ts` (each export's name, declaration kind and checker-printed type, union members sorted): 245 exports on both sides, digest `53af282f1e0f28e8…` on both. Positive control: `navId: string` made optional in a copy of the new `.d.ts` changes the digest.
- New: `views/studio-design/StudioNavItemInspector.d.ts` / `.js`. The package's `exports` map has `"."` only, so the new module is reachable only through the re-export.
</details>
